arithmetic: Exact rational arithmetic on binary64 native weights. This is not a certificate of floating-point rounding.

candidate_source.premise: Two nonnegative old states differ only by G5*delta_a*e5, delta_a>0, at one shared input. PRE0/PRE14/PRE15 are nonnegative at the endpoint with the larger old candidate.
candidate_source.proof: The three source gains are negative, so that endpoint has the smaller PRE. Its nonnegative reserves force those secants to 1. Every other receiver has an independent secant in [0,1].
candidate_source.consequence: The complete source raises row 7 relative to every rival, raises c, and lowers the new cutoff. At any shared following input the lower cutoff weakly suppresses the following candidate.
candidate_source.scope: Conditional source increments, not an absolute winner or true-rank certificate. The other 13 gates may change. Secant-box corners need not be jointly reachable.

false_record.scope: Exact rational family and one matched control. The cut acts only on old record neuron 4 during update 3, then native ReLUs resume. It is not a uniformly helpful inference rule. The true control loses margin but retains its correct winner.

candidate_demo.scope: A fixed native nine-input prefix supplies the full old state. Retention scales only old physical neuron 5 while holding the other 15 coordinates fixed; erased states are internal controls, not alternate input histories. Displayed numbers round exact rational results to binary64.
